$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 · docs/DESIGN_Glass_Windows.md §7 (CE-5033 GW-2) — rounds through a closed window crack its pane (two kept cracks), the third breaks it. The window is read by the window cue (the nearest glazed pane of House A to the point). Golden off until a measured run shows it repeats. Three riflemen, so three rounds cross the glass in the first seconds: 📐 measured with one, the man stepped 0.9 m aside after the second crack and every later round struck brick. Sampled every 0.05 s: three riflemen put the second and third rounds through the glass within a quarter second (📐 measured: one crack at 2.5 s, broken at 2.75 s).
